title: デビュー戦の後に・かちてー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finished her debut race, Tosen Jordan feels a passion for racing burning from within.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she isn't getting as much attention as other runners right now… she vows again to make it big.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But to do that, she has to prove her skills first! To that end, I recommend we set our sights on the Hopeful Stakes, a junior G1.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't tell me, but she begins reading up on the race on her own.
